stm.rule: STM is worth shipping if STM-only beats memory-off-llm on dependency checks (95% interval lower bound > 0) and is not worse on control checks (lower bound of the C difference > -0.05)

wm.rule: WM's model policy is the default under a host scope only if STM+WM beats STM-only on dependency checks (lower bound > 0) and its whole-run input tokens per passed task are at most 1.5x STM-only's; otherwise the deterministic policy is the default (without a scope the session is STM-only)
